entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit Customer Support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'Support' or 'Sales' to be routed to the correct department.
Connecting you to the next available agent.
Thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Hi Sarah... I, uh, I need to make a return. I just feel terrible about it. I've been a customer for so long and I hate doing this.
I completely understand, and there's no need to feel bad at all. We're here to help. Could you tell me the order number or the email address associated with your account?
Sure, it's david.peters@email.com. It's for the Trail Helmet I bought a couple of months back.
Okay, thank you, David. I'm pulling up your account now... Yes, I see the order for the Trail Helmet placed on September 24th. What seems to be the issue with it?

Well, it's nothing wrong with the helmet itself. I was so excited, but the color... it just wasn't what I expected when I saw it in person. To be honest, the box is still unopened. I've just been so busy and I really could use the money back right now.
I see. So it's just a matter of preference with the color. I can definitely look into the return options for you. Let me just confirm the delivery date... it looks like it was delivered 74 days ago.
Oh, has it been that long? I'm so sorry. I hope it's not too late. I was really counting on this.

Not at all, David. You are well within our 90-day return window for standard items. Since the box is unopened, the helmet's safety features are perfectly preserved. I can absolutely process this return for a full refund for you.
Really? Oh, thank you! That's such a huge relief. You have no idea.

Of course. And David, I see here that you're a VIP member with VeloFit. We really value your loyalty. As a thank you, I've gone ahead and emailed you a complimentary, prepaid return shipping label to make this as easy as possible. Just print it, attach it to the box, and drop it at any shipping center.
Wow, that's incredible. I was worried I'd have to pay for shipping. Sarah, you've been so helpful. Thank you so much!
You're very welcome. Once we receive the helmet, you'll see the refund back to your original payment method within 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. You've made my day. Thanks again!
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
